title: 국회행정심판위원회규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00245:20251205:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Rules on the Organization of the National Assembly Archives <National Assembly Rule No. 245, December 5, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on January 12, 2026.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Rules)
(1) through (7) Omitted.
(8) Part of the Rules on the National Assembly Administrative Appeals Committee shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2-2, "President of the National Assembly Budget Office and Director of the National Assembly Research Service" shall be replaced with "President of the National Assembly Budget Office, Director of the National Assembly Research Service, and Director of the National Assembly Archives".
(9) Omitted.
Article 3
Omitted.
